item.title: Ariane 6 successfully launches two Galileo satellites for the European Commission and ESA
item.description: Arianespace has successfully launched two Galileo navigation satellites on Ariane 6 from Europe's Spaceport.
item.content:encoded:
Arianespace has successfully launched two Galileo navigation satellites on Ariane 6 from Europe's Spaceport in French Guiana, on behalf of the European Commission and ESA.

Lift-off took place at 22:41 local time. The satellites separated from the upper stage after a flight of nearly four hours.

It was the second Ariane 6 flight dedicated to the Galileo programme.

item.title: Arianespace books Vega C launch for a Copernicus Sentinel mission
item.description: Arianespace and ESA signed a launch contract for a Copernicus Sentinel satellite on Vega C.
item.content:encoded:
Arianespace and ESA signed a launch contract for a Copernicus Sentinel satellite on Vega C, the launch company said.

The launch is planned from Europe's Spaceport. The satellite is built for the Copernicus Earth observation programme of the European Union.
